title: Multi-section settings with inline editing
expectations: One grouping strategy is used for every section of the page, not Cards in one section and bare Dividers in another.
Section titles all use the same heading level, and that level is one below the page title.
The content column is constrained to the width the design system specifies for settings and forms, not left to fill a dashboard-width page.
Every editable field has a persistent visible label, not a placeholder standing in for one.
Entering and leaving an inline edit does not change the row's height or shift the rows below it.
Destructive actions are separated from ordinary ones and name the object they act on.
Sensitive values are masked by default and the page says why, rather than showing them outright.
